set.revealHint: On a phone the buttons stay hidden so they don't cover anything. Tap the floating round button to light up every image field, then tap the one you need. Hold the floating button to open the manager, drag it to move it.
set.maxSide: Max image side on import (px, 0 = keep original)
set.maxSideHint: Images are downscaled when imported to keep the local database small. GIFs are never re-encoded.
set.help: Packs are stored locally in IndexedDB. The insert button appears next to any image file field — the gallery, avatars, reference image slots and so on.
